races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On Instagram Amateur Jockeys' Handicap

runners.name: Further Measure
runners.spotlight: Nine wins on the AW including one over C&D; 2lb lower than when successful at Kempton (2m, Polytrack) in February and makes the shortlist; jockey having her first ride under rules.
runners.comment: C&D winner and 2lb below last winning mark; makes the shortlist

runners.name: Beaune
runners.spotlight: Took him a while to get off the mark, but has won three times over 1m4f on the AW this year including one here (under Jessica Llewellyn); back off his last winning mark and holds each-way claims if seeing out the new trip.
runners.comment: Three wins over 1m4f on the AW this year; each-way claims if seeing out the new trip

runners.name: Circuit Breaker
runners.spotlight: Without a Flat win since September 2023, but is now 4lb lower than when third of 14 in a stronger race over C&D in April and drops into 0-70 company for the first time; much respected, especially if allowed his own way in front.
runners.comment: 4lb lower than when third of 14 in a stronger race over C&D in April; much respected

runners.name: Benvoy
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles last year before losing his way in that sphere; 0-6 on the Flat and has enough to prove back from four months off.
runners.comment: Three-time winner over hurdles last year, but 0-6 on the Flat; back from four months off

runners.name: Roland Garros
runners.spotlight: Was attempting this far for the first time on the Flat when third of eight at Kempton (2m, Polytrack) at the start of the month, but only fourth of seven back there (1m4f) six days ago; worth another go at the trip and holds each-way claims.
runners.comment: Finished third over this far at Kempton on penultimate start; worth another go at 2m

runners.name: Diamond Bay
runners.spotlight: C&D winner whose losing run is up to 16 despite a declining mark, but his second of three behind an improver (who has gone in again since) at Newbury (2m, good to firm) last month wasn't a bad effort; shortlisted.
runners.comment: C&D winner; has become well handicapped and latest effort wasn't bad; shortlisted

runners.name: Wise Counsellor
runners.spotlight: Showed ability on a few occasions for Andrew Balding last year, but little in five starts (four over hurdles) for Daniel Steele; now 0-13, but worth a market check starting out for another new yard (same owners).
runners.comment: Showed ability last year before losing his way; watch market on debut for another new yard

runners.name: Flamingo Rose
runners.spotlight: Not seen in 401 days, but she defied a 1241-day absence when making a successful stable debut on turf here (2m, good) in July last year; has twice finished runner-up on the AW and worth a second look; jockey having his first ride under rules.
runners.comment: Not seen in 401 days, but defied a 1241-day absence in July last year; worth a second look

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Band D) (Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Romotoso
runners.spotlight: Sent off 9-2 when a promising third of 12 on her Doncaster debut (6.5f, good to firm) 17 days ago; slight drop in trip may be a positive and this half-sister to an AW winner is a major player granted normal improvement.
runners.comment: Promising third of 12 on her Doncaster debut 17 days ago; major player

runners.name: Past Passion
runners.spotlight: Placed in three consecutive starts on varying ground over 5f on turf before finishing in midfield in the Super Sprint (100-1); extra furlong shouldn't be a problem and is a half-sister to a dual Polytrack winner, including around here; high on list.
runners.comment: Placed three times on turf before midfield in Super Sprint; should stay 6f; high on list

runners.name: Last Dandelion
runners.spotlight: Best effort when third of ten in a slowly run fillies' maiden over C&D in June, but hasn't fared any better in three subsequent starts on turf; return here a positive, but she will still need more; cheekpieces discarded after one use.
runners.comment: Best effort came over C&D in June, but hasn't built on it; will need more

runners.name: Musical Force
runners.spotlight: Improved from her debut effort when third of nine at Wolverhampton (7f, Tapeta) four weeks ago, though the trip just appeared to stretch her; one for the shortlist back at 6f.
runners.comment: Ran well when third at Wolverhampton last time, but trip just stretched her; shortlisted

runners.name: Enriched
runners.spotlight: March foal by Sergei Prokofiev; half-sister to winners Drama (6f including 2yo/AW; RPR 101), Thanos (7f/1m; 77) and Sidcot Swallet (Qatari 6f); dam 5f turf 2yo/6f AW winner (75), half-sister to 5f 2yo Group 3 winner Monsieur Chevalier; the only debutante in the field, but the stable has had a couple of winning 2yo newcomers this month; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Stable has had a couple of winning 2yo newcomers this month; worth a market check

runners.name: Polly The Sniper
runners.spotlight: 66-1 when fifth of six on her Windsor debut (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago; wasn't beaten far but still needs to improve.
runners.comment: Fifth of six on her Windsor debut 15 days ago; not beaten far but still needs to improve

runners.name: Nightspell
runners.spotlight: Sent off 22-1 and ran green when fourth of seven on her debut on turf here (6f, good to firm) last month; half-sister to a Polytrack winner and is open to improvement.
runners.comment: Green when fourth of seven on her debut on turf here last month; open to improvement

runners.name: It'sbeenemotional
runners.spotlight: Plenty of promise in her debut fourth of ten at Kempton (6f, Polytrack) in May, but regressed badly in two subsequent starts; has since left Tom Clover for 7,000gns and the change of scenery will need to have a major effect.
runners.comment: Promising debut but then regressed badly in next two starts; stable debut

runners.name: Mystic Unicorn
runners.spotlight: 66-1 when beating one home on her debut here (7f) a fortnight ago; may need more time and a return to further.
runners.comment: Beat one home on debut here a fortnight ago; may need more time and a return to further

runners.name: Pertinent
runners.spotlight: Big prices and beaten a long way in three starts over 5f/7f on turf; makes no appeal.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in three starts on turf; makes no appeal

races.race_name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Classified Stakes

runners.name: Pride Eye
runners.spotlight: Hasn't gone on since getting off the mark in a Southwell handicap (1m) in January, but steps up in trip in her first classified and may have more to give.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell in January; steps up in trip.

runners.name: Charles Morin
runners.spotlight: Placed in a couple of handicaps earlier this year but beaten 25l and 13l on last two Flat starts; has another change of headgear with blinkers replacing a visor but has plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Placed twice in handicaps this year but beaten 25l and 13l on last two Flat starts.

runners.name: Snooker McCrew
runners.spotlight: Won at this track (1m) for Stan Moore in 2024; has shown little in two starts for current yard since returning from a lengthy absence; the step up in trip in his first classified needs to have a positive impact.
runners.comment: Has shown little in two starts for current yard since returning from a lengthy absence.

runners.name: Douglas Dc
runners.spotlight: 0-27 on the Flat and although he was runner-up here on the turf track (11.5f, good to firm) two weeks ago, he does not appeal for win purposes.
runners.comment: Second here two weeks ago but 0-27 on the Flat.

runners.name: Churchill's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Well held in three similar contests this year; first-time cheekpieces replace blinkers and she needs to get her act together.
runners.comment: Well held in three similar contests this year.
runners.owner: Hambleton Racing Lvi & Mrs G Jarvis

runners.name: Someone's Wish
runners.spotlight: A fair winning hurdler/chaser for Gordon Elliott but signed off for that yard out of form and has been beaten a long way on his two runs for current handler; drops into his first classified and needs to show more.
runners.comment: Has been beaten a long way on his two runs for current handler.

runners.name: Star Suepreme
runners.spotlight: Well beaten at big prices in three maidens; this represents a significant drop in class and she steps up in trip; fascinating contender and any market move could be significant.
runners.comment: Well beaten at big prices in three maidens but this represents a drop in class.

runners.name: Foinix
runners.spotlight: Came from the rear to get up to win a similar contest over C&D last Tuesday; has more on his plate here with a 5lb penalty but current winning form is rare in such contests so he comes back here with decent claims.
runners.comment: Came from the rear to get up to win a similar contest over C&D last Tuesday.
runners.owner: M Robinson, Jack Pook & Jeanette May

runners.name: Summer Evening
runners.spotlight: Placed a couple of times in handicaps here (1m/1m2f) earlier in year after the cheekpieces went on, but the novelty seemed to wear off and she is now 0-16; steps back up in trip but hard to fancy.
runners.comment: Placed a couple of times in handicaps here earlier in year but out of sorts since.

runners.name: Fighting Poet
runners.spotlight: Has suffered some heavy defeats of late, but almost sprang a 80-1 surprise when only headed close home by Foinix over C&D last Tuesday; if he is able to back up that run then he comes here with a shout.
runners.comment: Almost sprang a 80-1 surprise when only headed close home by Foinix over C&D last Tuesday.

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap

runners.name: Grey Sands
runners.spotlight: Responded well to the fitting of cheekpiece when bolting up at Southwell (1m, Tapeta) in January on his final start for Joseph O'Brien, but he took a big hike in the weights and has looked held since; another 1lb drop not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: Took a big hike in the weights for his Southwell win in January and has looked held since

runners.name: My Old Mate
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on handicap/AW debut over C&D in April, but has suddenly taken off on turf lately with two wins at Windsor (1m, good to firm), the first under Jude Fernandes; has a 6lb penalty to carry, but still a major player if his progress can be transferred back to Polytrack.
runners.comment: Back to the AW in his bid for a hat-trick; major player despite 6lb penalty

runners.name: Henfield
runners.spotlight: Has improved since switched to this C&D with cheekpieces added, finishing second of ten behind a dual subsequent winner last month before narrowly winning a 0-50 classified event; this race will demand more, but something has clicked and she has less to prove than a few.
runners.comment: Has improved since switched to this C&D with cheekpieces added; less to prove than a few

runners.name: Ernie McCrew
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in seven starts and has a bit to find with Henfield on last month's C&D running.
runners.comment: Unplaced in seven starts and has a bit to find with Henfield on last month's C&D running

runners.name: Venturing
runners.spotlight: Hinted at ability in his final start for Donnacha O'Brien when fourth of 12 in a Dundalk maiden (1m, Polytrack) in February, but beaten a long way in two turf handicaps for this yard; best watched for now.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in two turf handicaps for this yard; best watched for now

runners.name: Ten Cuidado
runners.spotlight: Offered some promise when fourth of nine in a Wolverhampton maiden (7f, Tapeta) last November, but can't be entertained on his three efforts in the meantime.
runners.comment: Fourth at Wolverhampton last November, but can't be entertained on his efforts since

runners.name: Perfect Ruler
runners.spotlight: Didn't match up to market expectations in her first three starts for William Haggas, but ran better when fifth of ten on handicap debut at Redcar (7f, good) where she would have gone even closer with a clear run; makes her debut for her new yard after three months off having changed hands for 22,000gns last month; out of a Polytrack winner; watch market.
runners.comment: Makes her stable debut after three months off; out of a Polytrack winner; watch market

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div I)

runners.name: Edergole's Gift
runners.spotlight: C&D winner, but held at this level in her last two starts and needs to get back on track.
runners.comment: C&D winner, but held at this level in her last two starts and needs to get back on track

runners.name: Mademoiselle Belle
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 23 starts came in a handicap at Newcastle (5f, Tapeta) in February when trained by Brian Ellison; drops to this level for the first time, but has been well held in both starts for this yard and attempts this far for the first time; cheekpieces return.
runners.comment: Drops to this level for the first time, but well held in both starts for this yard

runners.name: Zaltalla
runners.spotlight: Sole success in 29 starts came in a handicap over C&D a year ago, but he has been running with credit in similar company here lately and is likely to go well again.
runners.comment: C&D winner; running with credit in similar company lately; likely to go well again

runners.name: Maury
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a handicap over C&D in March, but last three efforts not amongst his best; dropping to this grade for the first time one reason for optimism.
runners.comment: Sole success came in a handicap over C&D in March; drops to this grade for the first time

runners.name: She's Crafty
runners.spotlight: 0-13, but has twice finished runner-up including in a 0-60 handicap on turf here (7f, good) in May; twice well held since, but this is a drop in grade and possible frame material if producing her best.
runners.comment: 0-13, but this is a drop in grade and possible frame material if producing her best

runners.name: Raqraaq
runners.spotlight: Dual handicap winner over 1m here and finished third of nine in a 0-55 handicap over C&D in March, but has gone quiet again since.
runners.comment: Third of nine in a 0-55 handicap over C&D in March, but has gone quiet again since

runners.name: Victory Sound
runners.spotlight: Useful 2yo for Charles Hills and although a long way below that level now, his third-place finishes in handicaps here (1m) and at Ffos Las (7.4f, good) in March suggested that some ability remains; respected down to this level for the first time.
runners.comment: Not as good as he was but still seems to retain some ability; respected down to this level

runners.name: Turpin
runners.spotlight: Achieved his first placing at the 12th attempt when third of five in a handicap at Yarmouth (1m, good to firm) three weeks ago (first two have both won since); may have been unfortunate not to be placed in a similar race to this over 1m here the time before; each-way claims.
runners.comment: Better efforts in last two starts and latest form franked; each-way claims

runners.name: Dora Vita
runners.spotlight: 0-10 and may have been flattered when third of six in a 0-55 handicap at Leicester (1m, good to firm) on her penultimate start; others are more convincing.
runners.comment: 0-10 and may have been flattered on her penultimate start; others are more convincing

runners.name: Miraflores
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all 15 starts including twice at this level; difficult to enthuse over.
runners.comment: Unplaced all 15 starts including twice at this level; difficult to enthuse over

runners.name: Coiled
runners.spotlight: Has gone the wrong way since showing early promise for Eve Johnson Houghton and is now 0-18; hard to recommend, even at this level.
runners.comment: Has gone the wrong way and now 0-18; hard to recommend

runners.name: Hold The Press
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap over C&D in September 2023, but that his only success in 27 starts; plenty to prove back from six month off.
runners.comment: C&D winner but that his only success in 27 starts; plenty to prove back from six month off

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes (Div II)

runners.name: Crown The Future
runners.spotlight: Won a Wolverhampton nursery (7f, Tapeta) for Jack Morland last November, but well held in both starts since returning for this yard last month; needs to get back on track, but this is a drop in grade.
runners.comment: Well held since returning last month; needs to get back on track, but drops in grade

runners.name: Rovinia
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a Kempton handicap (7f, Polytrack) last October, but comes into this off the back of three consecutive runner-up finished in similar events on turf; should go well again.
runners.comment: Comes into after three consecutive runner-up finishes on turf; should go well again

runners.name: Chloe's Courage
runners.spotlight: One win in 19 starts came in a handicap at Chelmsford (7f, Polytrack; first-time blinkers) in December and only went down narrowly over this C&D later in month; not at her best in her last two starts, but this drop in grade gives her a chance.
runners.comment: Not at her best in her last two starts, but this drop in grade gives her a chance

runners.name: Megaphone
runners.spotlight: 0-19 since winning twice early last year but has run with credit in a few handicaps this year and looks frame material; never dangerous from the widest draw in the 7.40 Wolverhampton (5f; his first classified) on Monday but made some late headway.
runners.comment: Never dangerous yesterday; ran with credit in a few handicaps this year; frame material

runners.name: Vitalline
runners.spotlight: Not very consistent, but has won nine races, eight on the AW; twice well held since winning a handicap at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) in June, but more than capable of playing a part if on a going day.
runners.comment: Not very consistent, but has won nine races; capable of playing a part if on a going day

runners.name: Power Cut
runners.spotlight: Hasn't threatened in five starts over 5f/6f on the AW; drops in grade, but probably only of interest if backed.
runners.comment: Hasn't threatened in five starts; drops in grade, but probably only of interest if backed

runners.name: Horus
runners.spotlight: 1-23, the win coming in a nursery here (6f) at the end of 2024; will need to improve on recent efforts if he is to double his tally.
runners.comment: Won a 6f nursery here as a 2yo; will need to improve on recent efforts to double his tally

runners.name: Ruiz
runners.spotlight: Hasn't finished within 10l of the winner in seven starts; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Hasn't finished within 10l of the winner in seven starts; look elsewhere

runners.name: Regal Guest
runners.spotlight: Made a promising return when third of 11 in a novice at Kempton (7f, Polytrack) in March last year, but has come nowhere near that form since; drops in grade, but still needs a resurgence.
runners.comment: Hasn't built on a promising return early last year; drops in grade, but needs a resurgence

runners.name: No News
runners.spotlight: 0-23 since winning a pair of Kempton handicaps (7f, Polytrack) in the winter of 2023/24; only found one too good in a handicap at Wolverhampton (6f, Tapeta) last month, but his subsequent effort underlined his inconsistency.
runners.comment: 0-23 since winning a pair of Kempton handicaps in the winter of 2023/24; inconsistent

runners.name: Dupont Circle
runners.spotlight: Beaten a long way in all four starts; drops in grade with blinkers added, but still hard to warm to.
runners.comment: Beaten a long way in four starts; drops in grade but still hard to warm to; blinkers on
runners.owner: The Limes Of Epsom Racing Club

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Peregrine Falcon
runners.spotlight: Placed on nine occasions, but now 0-16 and 5f appears to suit her best; another frame finish may be her best hope.
runners.comment: Placed on nine occasions, but now 0-16; another frame finish may be her best hope

runners.name: Balon d'Or
runners.spotlight: 3-37 with two of his wins coming at Chester; one of his better efforts since joining this yard when beaten just over 2l into fourth of ten over C&D a fortnight ago; worth considering from 7lb below his last winning mark.
runners.comment: Ran with credit over C&D last time and 7lb below his last winning mark; worth considering

runners.name: Express Train
runners.spotlight: Emphatic winner of a Leicester novice (6f, good to firm) for Andrew Balding in July last year, but inconsistent since and well held in both starts since returning for this yard last month; others preferred.
runners.comment: Well held in both starts since returning for this yard last month; others preferred

runners.name: Alashos
runners.spotlight: Doubled his winning tally when successful over C&D in April; twice unplaced on turf since and still 5lb higher than for that latest win, but still one for the shortlist returned here.
runners.comment: 5lb higher than when winning over C&D in April, but still one for the shortlist

runners.name: Diamond Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Last three wins have come over 5f but he has won three times over 6f, including around here; held lately, but he drops to this level for the first time in over two years and is 4-9 in 0-60 handicaps or lower; interesting.
runners.comment: Drops to this level for the first time in over two years; 4-9 in 0-60 handicaps or lower

runners.name: Dashing Donkey
runners.spotlight: Front-runner who has dropped 3lb lower than for the latest of two wins at Newmarket (1m, good to soft) last summer; has never tackled a trip this short before, though.
runners.comment: 3lb below last winning mark, but has never tackled a trip this short before

runners.name: Porfin
runners.spotlight: Having his 119th start; off the same mark as when winning over C&D in January, but others are more compelling.
runners.comment: Off the same mark as when winning over C&D in January, but others are more compelling

runners.name: Due Date
runners.spotlight: Seven wins on the AW elsewhere; surrounded by subsequent winners when beaten half a length into second of five at Leicester (6f, good to firm) last month and a 1lb rise still leaves him 6lb below his last winning mark; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Just beaten at Leicester last time; 1lb rise still leaves him 6lb below last winning mark
runners.owner: A Bangs & Miss J A Challen

runners.name: Happier
runners.spotlight: Returned to winning form in a 0-50 classified event at Wolverhampton (5f, Tapeta) last month and followed up in a 0-65 handicap at Ffos Las (5f, good) six days ago; has a 5lb penalty to carry, but still respected in her current mood and the return to this trip is no problem.
runners.comment: Has a 5lb penalty to carry in her hat-trick bid, but still respected in her current mood

runners.name: Big Bard
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner including one over C&D; 2lb lower than when successful at Kempton (6f, Polytrack) in January, but well held in all three starts since and is hard to predict.
runners.comment: C&D winner; 2lb below his last winning mark, but is hard to predict

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Von Krolock
runners.spotlight: Won on Polytrack in Ireland; three Wolverhampton AW wins for this yard, seemingly suited by the return to 6f when drawing clear in April; respectable efforts on turf either side of a break since (visor discarded latest, blinkers now refitted) and he's relatively unexposed at this trip on the AW so could have some improvement to come.
runners.comment: Relatively unexposed over 6f on AW so may improve on his Wolverhampton win in April

runners.name: Walking On Clouds
runners.spotlight: Particularly successful on Tapeta but he was a wide-margin winner over C&D in June and again won from the front at Wolverhampton in his only subsequent AW run; the chasers were closing there but he had the race in the bag from some way out and, back up 3lb, he looks sure to go well again.
runners.comment: Won last two AW races from the front, over C&D and at Wolverhampton; looks sure to go well

runners.name: Henry Tudor
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in a 6f classified on Chelmsford AW in February; his handicap form since hasn't come up to scratch and although he wasn't beaten far in a C&D classified last time he has more to prove back at this level.
runners.comment: Won 6f AW classified in February; close up over C&D latest; more to prove back in handicap

runners.name: Chasing Gold
runners.spotlight: In good form over 6f on turf since blinkered, winning at Yarmouth in June and going down narrowly there last month; having first AW run since before Christmas but he was in good form then and a bold show looks likely.
runners.comment: In good form over 6f on turf; acts well on Polytrack and should go well back on the AW

runners.name: Twilight Madness
runners.spotlight: Multiple AW wins include two over this C&D, although his most recent success came on turf in April; has taken rather a drastic wrong turn since, though, and refitting cheekpieces (now discarded) made no difference back on this track last time.
runners.comment: Multiple AW wins include two over this C&D; taken wrong turn since turf win in April
runners.owner: P R Hedger & P C F Racing Ltd

runners.name: Woolridge
runners.spotlight: Not yet off the mark and he was down the field on turf at Doncaster when last seen in June but he acted well on Polytrack in Ireland and a close third of 12 on Newcastle Tapeta (6f) in May was encouraging; possibilities.
runners.comment: Maiden; had Polytrack form in Ireland; close 3rd at Newcastle on latest AW run in May

runners.name: Court Of Session
runners.spotlight: Course winner at 1m; a good spell in the New Year included a 7f win on Wolverhampton AW and he was back on song when winning over 6f at Nottingham in June; soft ground perhaps not helpful on next two starts but he has a bit to prove on his first C&D run.
runners.comment: Course winner at 1m; has won over 7f (AW) and 6f (turf) this year; now has first C&D run

runners.name: Unico
runners.spotlight: Has won on Chelmsford Polytrack but her handicap wins have come on turf, most recently at Brighton (extended 5f) last September; minor form on last three starts and she's down the list for now.
runners.comment: Has won on Polytrack but handicap wins on turf; minor form on last 3 starts; down the list

runners.name: My Mate Kev
runners.spotlight: Won 6f maiden on Chelmsford Polytrack as a 2yo and he looked a useful prospect when winning a 6f handicap at Newmarket in May 2025; however, he's had more horses in front of him than behind ever since and wind surgery (his second) since last seen in May needs to have made a big difference.
runners.comment: Has won on Polytrack; looked good for 6f turf win last May; modest since; had wind surgery

races.race_name: Community Engagement Programme Handicap

runners.name: Hope Rising
runners.spotlight: Refused to race on last visit here when due to contest a handicap hurdle in October; won over an extended 1m3f and 2m back on the Flat this month, scoring by 19l last week at Nottingham when 2lb well in under a penalty; that was an apprentice race so has no penalty.
runners.comment: 19l winner of an apprentice race last week so has no penalty to carry

runners.name: Sneaky Blinder
runners.spotlight: Only 1-16 on turf Flat and 5-25 on the AW, but latest return to form at Kempton (2m) bodes well for him giving Hope Rising something to think about.
runners.comment: Most effective on the AW but comes here on the back of a return to form at Kempton

races.race_name: Trade Centre Group Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Delighfully Hot
runners.spotlight: Has got closer with each run, last time going down by only a neck at Sandown (5f); the two she split have both won since; hard to beat.
runners.comment: Has got closer with each run, last time going down by only a neck at Sandown

runners.name: Sioux Moon
runners.spotlight: Outpaced when it mattered at Leicester (6f; 18-1), beating just the one home; has to improve on that effort.
runners.comment: Outpaced when it mattered at Leicester (6f; 18-1), beating just the one home

runners.name: Soeur De Flash
runners.spotlight: Inexperience evident at Windsor (6f; tongue tied) so did well to go close in a bunched finish; that wasn't a strong race but it's something to build on.
runners.comment: Inexperience evident at Windsor so did well to go close in a bunched finish

runners.name: Impulsive Spirit
runners.spotlight: Has to be taken seriously as an £85,000 breeze-up buy and she's a half-sister to 5f turf 2yo/6f AW winner Powerdress (RPR 88); best to let the market guide.
runners.comment: Has to be taken seriously as an £85,000 breeze-up buy

runners.name: Rogue Dakota
runners.spotlight: 13-2 when a 3l second over C&D 12 days ago; a line through the winner gives her something to find with Delighfully Hot.
runners.comment: A line through debut conqueror gives her something to find with Delighfully Hot

runners.name: Happy Enough
runners.spotlight: Both runs at 6f, finishing last at Newmarket and nearly last at Salisbury; probably one for a nursery.
runners.comment: Both runs at 6f, finishing last at Newmarket and nearly last at Salisbury
runners.owner: Whitsbury Manor Stud And Mrs M E Slade

runners.name: Kokumi
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling by Blackbeard; no match for a classy filly (second in a Listed race last Friday) over Beverley's 5f but ran well for a long way and should improve.
runners.comment: Second at Beverley, no match for a classy filly who was placed at Listed level last week

runners.name: Marzad
runners.spotlight: Beaten 11l when 25-1 for recent debut here, finishing 8l behind Rogue Dakota.
runners.comment: Beaten 11l when 25-1 for recent debut here, finishing 8l behind Rogue Dakota

races.race_name: Bailey Family Investments / EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Avionics
runners.spotlight: Encouraging second at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) but took a backward step at Ffos Las where he pulled hard and dropped away; could be given another chance but he's up against a good prospect in Grove Street.
runners.comment: Second at Salisbury but pulled too hard when a fader at Ffos Las

runners.name: Grove Street
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns foal out of a 1m/1m4f winner; stable's juveniles are well known for improving on their initial efforts and this colt pushed last week's Listed winner Quest For Stars close when making his debut at Sandown (7f, good to firm; 16-1); has two Group 2 entries.
runners.comment: Has Group 2 entries and the form of his second at Sandown has been franked

runners.name: Highland Frost
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to 1m4f AW winner Havachoc (RPR 67); dam 7f 2yo/1m2f Flat (95) and 2m hurdle winner; likely best watched.
runners.comment: Third foal; half-brother to 1m4f AW winner Havachoc (RPR 67)

runners.name: Talamon
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; brother to 7f/1m winner Bill The Butcher (RPR 91) and half-brother to three winners including Fev Rover (7f-1m2f; Canadian Grade 1; 118) and Patrol (1m 2yo/1m4f AW; 85); dam 7f 2yo winner (83); in good hands and the market should be revealing.
runners.comment: Well related colt in good hands and the market should be revealing

runners.name: La Bassette
runners.spotlight: 160,000euros yearling by Wootton Bassett; contested a traditionally warm maiden at Glorious Goodwood (7f, good to firm) but she was never remotely threatening from off the pace at odds of 28-1; the only filly in this field and other runners appeal more.
runners.comment: Ran in a good maiden at Goodwood but never remotely threatened from off the pace

runners.name: It's A Dream
runners.spotlight: Has posted modest RPRs in his first two races and likely to be outclassed while kept to maidens.
runners.comment: Modest RPRs in his first two races and likely to be outclassed while kept to maidens
runners.owner: P J & Mrs J P Haycock

races.race_name: Trade Centre Wales Handicap (Chepstow Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.name: Law Of Design
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 7f novice at Ascot as 2yo; smart handicap form there (7f, soft) last September, when a close third of 12 in a much better race than this under Billy Loughnane, who rides him for the first time in 2026; not yet recaptured form for this yard but he's dropped right down the weights and this is his best chance of the year; cheekpieces refitted.
runners.comment: Below best for this yard but well treated on 2025 form and B Loughnane back up

runners.name: Scarfo
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 23 turf starts came over C&D in June; two good efforts in his next two course starts (on good and good to firm) but his finishing effort was muted over C&D nine days ago; in the thick of it on the earlier form.
runners.comment: C&D winner in June; lesser run here last time but in the thick of it on earlier efforts

runners.name: Rating
runners.spotlight: First turf win when beating three rivals at Bath (1m, firm) in May; she's run creditably over this C&D in the meantime, notably when checked in her run but keeping at it two starts ago; lesser run next time but she's run well both times Rossa Ryan has ridden her and should do so again.
runners.comment: First turf win in May (1m, firm); has C&D form; should run well now reunited with R Ryan

runners.name: Ajrad
runners.spotlight: The winner of three of his six C&D starts (good and good to firm), all in July or August; well treated these days and he looked on the way back when hampered over 7f here in July and he again didn't get the clearest of runs over C&D nine days ago; solid contender.
runners.comment: Won 3 of 6 C&D starts; well treated now; encouraging runs on last two starts; solid

runners.name: Bobby Dassler
runners.spotlight: All three wins at about 1m, most recently over C&D in June (good; has won on good to firm), but his form has taken a turn for the worse since, over 1m (on two occasions) and 1m4f; has plenty to prove; usually wears aids but not today.
runners.comment: Latest win over C&D in June; soundly beaten since; goes without regular aids

runners.name: Look Back Smiling
runners.spotlight: Has done his winning at trips between 6f and 1m; losing run goes back to March 2024 but, following a spell in the doldrums for previous yard and this one, he's been back in better form of late, doing some good late work on the AW at Kempton (1m) and Wolverhampton (about 1m1f); can be involved with Tom Marquand up for the first time
runners.comment: Losing run goes back to 2024 but back in better form on AW for new yard; can be involved

runners.name: Risen Again
runners.spotlight: Broke duck at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) in May 2025 and some good efforts in defeat followed later in the year; however, it's been a slow process recapturing form for new yard and was well held when second of five back at Yarmouth recently; no good thing to take advantage of a tempting mark.
runners.comment: Below best for new yard in 2026 and no good thing to take advantage of a tempting mark

runners.name: Counting Cards
runners.spotlight: Maiden who made an encouraging return from an absence on the AW (1m) last October but he hasn't achieved a lot since and was beaten a fair way out at Ffos Las in July on his yard debut; one to watch for now.
runners.comment: Maiden; out of sorts in 2026 and ran poorly on yard debut in July; one to watch for now

races.race_name: Trade Centre UK Handicap

runners.name: Espona Bay
runners.spotlight: AW winner who doubled his tally when grabbing the favoured stands' rail here 12 days ago; prevailed by only half a length and has a 5lb higher mark today (also had claimed 3lb off his back last time); perhaps vulnerable.
runners.comment: Narrow win when claimer ridden over C&D 12 days ago; perhaps vulnerable off revised mark

runners.name: Von Trotter
runners.spotlight: Took nine races to get off the mark but he was quite convincing in the end at Doncaster (7f) 17 days ago; should be very competitive off 7lb higher if in similar form.
runners.comment: Quite convincing at Doncaster and should be competitive off this 7lb higher mark

runners.name: Too Much Trevor
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in July off 2lb lower; below that level since and he's the most exposed of these (2-36).
runners.comment: C&D win in July off 2lb lower; below that level since and he's the most exposed of these

runners.name: Honky Tonk Girl
runners.spotlight: Looked in a spot of bother over Bath's extended 5f (firm) but came home the best, albeit at odds-on in a modest race (form let down since); it's unlikely she has a great deal in hand off this mark in her first handicap, but this is perhaps more her trip.
runners.comment: Stayed on best over Bath's extended 5f to win a modest novice; handicap debut

runners.name: Evie Ross
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f maiden here (good to firm) last August on her second start; hasn't kicked on in handicaps over 6f and she'll need to accept the new headgear (blinkered for previous runs) if she's to see out this longer trip.
runners.comment: 5f maiden; hasn't kicked on in 6f handicaps; blinkers are replaced by a visor
runners.owner: S R Hope And S W Barrow

runners.name: Rogue Exile
runners.spotlight: Second at Yarmouth and still looked green when narrowly justifying prohibitive odds at Lingfield (7f, good to firm); has the potential to deal with this sort of mark now handicapping.
runners.comment: Lingfield winner; has the potential to deal with this sort of mark now handicapping

runners.name: Name The Day
runners.spotlight: Won her maiden over C&D in July but has finished last in both her handicaps, over 1m and an extended 7f (latterly tongue tied); something to prove all of a sudden.
runners.comment: Won her maiden over C&D in July but has finished last in both her handicaps

races.race_name: Saxon Automobiles Handicap

runners.name: Some Nightmare
runners.spotlight: Six-time course winner who's been on the downgrade for some time and is on a losing run of 18; remains consistent enough but, like stablemate Marisitta, has a job on with Arnaz on the same terms as last Sunday.
runners.comment: Six-time course winner; on the downgrade for some time; behind two of these latest
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould & Partner

runners.name: Arnaz
runners.spotlight: Pulled hard on his first two runs back from wind surgery (7f) and was much happier being allowed to stride on when easily winning an apprentice handicap over C&D last Sunday; no penalty and he can only look well treated now back in the groove.
runners.comment: No penalty for easy C&D win last Sunday; can only look well treated now back in the groove

runners.name: Connie's Rose
runners.spotlight: Seven-time course winner who's become hard to win with, landing just one of her last 30 starts; she's not been this low in the weights for years but isn't as good now; yard also responsible for Savannah Smiles.
runners.comment: Seven-time course winner who's become hard to win; well treated but isn't as good now

runners.name: Savannah Smiles
runners.spotlight: Well backed and took advantage of a sliding mark when winning an uncompetitive small-field handicap off 3lb lower at Lingfield (turf) in June; always liked it here but this mark is as high as she's ever won off, so there's little margin for error.
runners.comment: Acts well here but this mark is as high as she's ever won off, so little margin for error

runners.name: Zoulu Warrior
runners.spotlight: Seems happiest on Tapeta, albeit he's a course winner, and has still to prove he's up to this mark on turf; two poor efforts this summer, after a break, leave him some way down the pecking order.
runners.comment: Two poor efforts this summer, back from a break, leave him some way down the pecking order

runners.name: Benavente
runners.spotlight: Seven-time AW winner (7f-1m4f) when trained in Ireland, latterly in a Dundalk claimer in March; has failed to make the frame in 13 starts on grass, though, hence his much lower turf mark; lots to prove for his new yard.
runners.comment: Failed to make the frame in 13 starts on grass in Ireland; lots to prove for his new yard

runners.name: Marisitta
runners.spotlight: C&D winner in June (drop to 6f helped) off 5lb lower, who finished best of the rest, and just ahead of stablemate Some Nightmare, behind Arnaz here nine days ago; will do well to turn that round on the same terms.
runners.comment: Second to Arnaz here nine days ago; will do well to turn that round on the same terms

runners.name: Calafrio
runners.spotlight: Kempton win last autumn came when she was fresh, as did her Leicester victory three weeks ago (during a good spell for yard; gone quieter since); a 5lb rise for winning that small-field affair from the front will test her.
runners.comment: Goes well fresh; 5lb rise for winning a small-field affair from the front will test her

runners.name: Vape
runners.spotlight: Won this last year, one of three C&D victories, for Charlie Tucker off a 2lb higher mark in a small field; yard enjoying a better spell of late and this may have been the plan but he doesn't arrive in the same form as last year; the years might be catching up.
runners.comment: Won this last year, one of three C&D victories; doesn't arrive in the same form this time

runners.name: Le Beau Garcon
runners.spotlight: On a career-low mark for a yard that doesn't send many here and he is worth tracking in the market; seems on the downgrade, though, and he hasn't run at beyond 5f since 2023; others make more obvious appeal.
runners.comment: On a career-low mark and worth tracking in the market; hasn't run at beyond 5f since 2023

races.race_name: QuinnBet Apprentice Optional Claiming Race

runners.name: Kashel Spring
runners.spotlight: Twice successful for Joseph O'Brien last year; has failed to take to hurdling for this stable; well below best on both Flat starts this term; needs to step up from a poor Ballinrobe run behind She's Ideal; highest-rated of Denis Hogan's three runners, so might be unwise to ignore
runners.comment: Highest-rated of Denis Hogan's three runners, needs to step up from a poor Ballinrobe run

runners.name: Forlio
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner, went up 11lb for a convincing success in a 1m4f handicap at Tramore last month; subsequent runs in a Flat handicap at Galway and a maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan raise significant doubts; well enough treated by the race conditions if recapturing form.
runners.comment: Tramore winner over 1m4f three starts ago, two subsequent runs raise significant doubts

runners.name: Moyassr
runners.spotlight: Fine record on AW (4-10), 1-18 on turf, unconvincing form since Fairyhouse win in May; would receive 9lb from stablemate Forlio in a handicap.
runners.comment: Fine record on AW (4-10), 1-18 on turf, unconvincing form since Fairyhouse win in May

runners.name: She's Ideal
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably in a couple of handicaps earlier this season; several less encouraging displays before winning a claimer for Paul Flynn at Ballinrobe last month; raised 6lb for winning a 0-60 handicap at Gowran last week on debut for Ado McGuinness; had a fairly hard race, but has a strong chance if fully recovered.
runners.comment: Two wins in recent weeks, had a hard race at Gowran, strong chance if fully recovered

runners.name: Concert Party
runners.spotlight: Two wins for Richard Hannon, both over 1m2f on easy ground; modest form so far over hurdles and on the Flat for this yard; soundly beaten in the Ballinrobe claimer won by She's Ideal; struggled at Sligo last time; cheekpieces tried now.
runners.comment: Won twice for Richard Hannon last autumn, has failed to find her best form this year

runners.name: Bucaneer's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Holding his form generally well since an early-season win at Cork, apart from a below-par run at Ballinrobe last month; back to form with a solid effort in finishing fourth of 17 at Galway only eight days later.
runners.comment: Holding his form well since an early-season win at Cork, solid effort at Galway last month

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: One of three for yard; took a big climb in the ratings for a Gowran win; hung badly left when in rear in a handicap at Galway; well beaten in a claimer at Gowran recently.
runners.comment: Took a big climb in the ratings for a Gowran win, well beaten in a claimer there recently

runners.name: Darkdeserthighway
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner; sole success on turf came in 2021; despite negatives attached to her turf record and a hefty burden, holds a definite chance on her second in a 22-runner handicap at Leopardstown 12 days ago.
runners.comment: Has a stronger record on AW, fine effort at Leopardstown last time, has a big burden here

runners.name: Loingseoir
runners.spotlight: Veteran seven-time winner; has a good record at this track, one win and two seconds from four visits; has been running consistently in handicaps; capable of reaching the money in a race of this standard.
runners.comment: Winner of seven races, at the veteran stage, has been running consistently in handicaps
runners.owner: W Keeling & M C Grassick & Mrs M J Grassick

runners.name: Kakori
runners.spotlight: fair sixth in a 20-runner handicap over 1m5f at Navan in April, beaten only 3l and would have been closer with a clear run; another respectable run when third in a 1m4f event of this type at Limerick in June; shorter trip might not be ideal.
runners.comment: Seems to be improving gradually, her two best displays have been over longer distances

runners.name: Phidias Ovation
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in maidens; struggled at Fairyhouse in his first handicap; not suited by the race conditions; two items of headgear added.
runners.comment: Ordinary form in maidens, struggled at Fairyhouse in his first handicap, hard to fancy

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden

runners.name: Cashel Queen
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at Leopardstown over 7f (soft) and built on that over a mile at Bellewstown on good ground; 7f seemed a little too sharp at Down Royal; one of the more likely contenders despite a reservation about the trip.
runners.comment: Best of her three runs was over 1m at Bellewstown, 7f seemed too sharp at Down Royal

runners.name: Someday Somewhere
runners.spotlight: Definite promise when third behind an odds-on chance on debut at Leopardstown; confirmed ability when fourth at Galway; capable of making her presence felt.
runners.comment: Definite promise in races at Leopardstown and Galway, capable of making her presence felt

runners.name: Nando Royale
runners.spotlight: Noted staying on when sixth of 17 on debut over 6f at Fairyhouse; third in a C&D maiden seven weeks ago; form is working out well enough to give him a decent chance, second and fifth have both won.
runners.comment: Third in a C&D maiden in June, form is working out well enough to give him a decent chance
runners.owner: Kiva Cromwell & Coragh Bloodstock Limited & Fergus Grimes

runners.name: Luca Brillante
runners.spotlight: Finished with only one behind her when 33-1 on debut at Naas in May; showed good progress from that when seventh of 19 at the Curragh nine days ago; needs to find more, may be capable of doing so.
runners.comment: Showed good progress from her debut when seventh of 19 at the Curragh, needs to find more

runners.name: Eighteenth Smiles
runners.spotlight: No sign of progression in maidens; had a troubled passage in a Galway nursery won by a stablemate; that was mildly encouraging, but he needs to improve considerably to win a maiden.
runners.comment: Had a troubled passage in a Galway nursery, needs to improve considerably to win a maiden

runners.name: Hypiradon
runners.spotlight: Hinted at improvement at Galway on his second outing; finished only one length behind fourth-placed Someday Somewhere in a 7f maiden.
runners.comment: Hinted at improvement at Galway, only one length behind fourth-placed Someday Somewhere

runners.name: Pints Of Glory
runners.spotlight: From a top stable but not one of the stronger contenders on the evidence of runs at Killarney and Leopardstown.
runners.comment: Not one of the stronger contenders on the evidence of runs at Killarney and Leopardstown

runners.name: Prince Of Peppard
runners.spotlight: Dropped away in the final quarter-mile when 100-1 chance first time out at the Curragh; had plenty of horses behind him when sixth at Naas on his second start, fifth-placed Ile De France won at Dundalk on Saturday; first time with cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Had plenty of horses behind him when sixth at Naas last month, fifth won on AW on Saturday

runners.name: Honey Deuce
runners.spotlight: Beaten further at Leopardstown last month than at the same venue on debut; up against it.
runners.comment: Beaten further at Leopardstown last month than at the same venue on debut, up against it

runners.name: Captain James Cook
runners.spotlight: Last-but-one in his first two races; perhaps premature to write off since he cost 500,000gns as a yearling and is a half-brother to a Group 1 winner; however, hard to make a logical case for him.
runners.comment: Last-but-one in his first two races, premature to write off but hard to make a case

runners.name: Matavai Bay
runners.spotlight: Showed a little at Sligo on her second outing; will probably need to get a handicap mark.
runners.comment: Showed a little at Sligo on her second outing, will probably need to get a handicap mark

runners.name: Green Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Looks more like a handicap prospect than a potential maiden winner after two Curragh outings; hooded now.
runners.comment: Looks more like a handicap prospect after two Curragh outings, hooded now

races.race_name: Irish EBF Auction Series Race (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Lars Soldier
runners.spotlight: Won a Curragh maiden over 5f in heavy ground on second start; posted a solid effort in a 6f Group 3 next time; a couple of lesser efforts over 6f before a good run over 5f at Cork last time; some of these may have an edge over him in terms of stamina.
runners.comment: Has plenty of experience, best form over 5f, some of these may have more stamina

runners.name: Oristown Boy
runners.spotlight: Finished strongly when fourth to Noble Agenda at Down Royal; stayed 7f well when winning at Galway; Noble Agenda may have his measure again.
runners.comment: Finished strongly when fourth to Noble Agenda at Down Royal, stayed 7f well at Galway

runners.name: Sword Of State
runners.spotlight: Made all for an emphatic win at Gowran on her second outing, beating a 79-rated rival who has since finished third to Oristown Boy at Galway; can hold her own with the colts and geldings here.
runners.comment: Made all for an emphatic win at Gowran, can hold her own with the colts and geldings here

runners.name: Emotional Hedging
runners.spotlight: Chased home a well-fancied filly at Sligo on debut; improvement likely, but might not match some of the previous winners.
runners.comment: Chased home a well-fancied filly at Sligo, improvement likely from that initial outing

runners.name: Green Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Stable second-choice on debut in Killarney maiden, shaped well in fifth; looked useful when beating subsequent Curragh winner Shakespeare at Leopardstown only ten days later; significant that the champion jockey prefers him to the 92-rated Seven Nation Army; the only horse in the race with Group 1 entries.
runners.comment: Looked smart when beating a subsequent Curragh winner at Leopardstown,  Group 1-entered

runners.name: Seven Nation Army
runners.spotlight: Given three runs in nine days in May to get a handicap mark; lost out narrowly at the Curragh in his first handicap; made short work of his rivals in a Galway nursery; now rated 92, 18lb above initial mark; should win more races, but Dylan Browne McMonagle prefers the less experienced Green Dreamer.
runners.comment: Made short work of his rivals in a Galway nursery, stable's Green Dreamer may be superior

runners.name: Grit And Glory
runners.spotlight: Already fading when hampered at Leopardstown; likely to need more experience.
runners.comment: Already fading when hampered at Leopardstown, likely to need more experience

runners.name: Gabby Hayes
runners.spotlight: Never looked like posing a threat in the Galway maiden won by Oristown Boy; huge task here.
runners.comment: Never looked like posing a threat in the Galway maiden won by Oristown Boy

runners.name: Noble Agenda
runners.spotlight: Won quite snugly on debut at Down Royal two winners; several subsequent winners behind then, including two Galway festival scorers, Joga Bonito and today's rival Oristown Boy; promising sort.
runners.comment: Won quite snugly on debut at Down Royal, subsequent winners behind including Oristown Boy
runners.owner: Steven I Weston & Steven Rocco & Steven Bouchey

races.race_name: SIS Supporting Irish Racing Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Beatific
runners.spotlight: Frankel filly started her career with a fifth placing in a 1m Leopardstown maiden in which the subsequent Oaks winner Thundering On was second; again fifth in a 1m2f maiden at the same venue, beaten 9 1/2l behind the Irish Oaks Johanna Walsh; not much improvement in evidence at Naas on third start.
runners.comment: Form of her first two runs is linked to top-class fillies, no sign of progress on latest

runners.name: Almeiyda
runners.spotlight: Fair fourth over 1m at Leopardstown on the second of two starts at two; appeared not to see out the extended 1m1f at Gowran on return; better when going close over C&D; looks the part now after a Galway run that can be upgraded a little since she suffered interference from a loose horse.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D, looks the part now after a Galway run that can be upgraded a little
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Stooked
runners.spotlight: Made a promising debut when beaten a head by a more experienced rival at the Curragh, form upheld by the winner in landing a handicap at Gowran; probably found 6f inadequate when runner-up at Cork only six days later; almost sure to be in the mix.
runners.comment: Runner-up in maidens over 7f at the Curragh and 6f at Cork, almost sure to be in the mix

runners.name: Andaman Fifty
runners.spotlight: Made a promising debut at Sligo, taking the runner-up spot despite betraying inexperience; got going too late at Cork and appears held by Stooked; both fillies are likely to appreciate the extra furlong.
runners.comment: Promising debut at Sligo despite betraying inexperience, held by Stooked on Cork running

runners.name: Quinta Girl
runners.spotlight: Best effort at two when a close fourth in a 6f Naas maiden; flopped in a Dundalk nursery on final start before the winter; made a pleasing return at the Curragh; failed to build on that at Limerick; needs extra.
runners.comment: Made a pleasing return at the Curragh, failed to build on that at Limerick, needs extra
runners.owner: J Kirkland & Mrs J M Ryan

runners.name: Divine Legend
runners.spotlight: Took a step in the right direction at Limerick in April; more needed now after a break; others preferred.
runners.comment: Took a step in the right direction at Limerick in April, more needed now after a break
runners.owner: Exors of the Late J Connaughton

runners.name: C'Est Comme Ca
runners.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister by Kodi Bear to three winners including Aquamerica (French Listed-placed); dam 1m2f winner, half-sister to US 1m Grade 3 winner Doc Holiday.
runners.comment: Ninth foal, half-sister by Kodi Bear to three winners, dam 1m2f winner,

runners.name: Gentle Soda
runners.spotlight: Third foal; Churchill filly is closely related to Kashel Spring who won twice for Joseph O'Brien last year.
runners.comment: Churchill filly, closely related to Kashel Spring who won twice for Joseph O'Brien

runners.name: Flower Forest
runners.spotlight: Siyouni filly out of 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Coolmore, sister to Group 1 winners Gleneagles, Marvellous, Happily, and Joan Of Arc; 10-1 stable second-string when fourth over 7f at Cork in April on testing ground (odds-on stablemate was second and won easily next time).
runners.comment: Terrific pedigree, fourth in testing going on only start at two, has to be taken seriously
runners.owner: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith

runners.name: River Trieux
runners.spotlight: 30,000gns yearling; fourth foal; Havana Grey filly; dam unraced half-sister to two useful French winners; trainer also runs the twice-raced Andaman Fifty who has been placed.
runners.comment: Newcomer by Havana Grey, trainer also runs Andaman Fifty who has been placed

runners.name: Brise Fraiche
runners.spotlight: E200,000 yearling; second foal; by French Classic winner Victor Ludorum; dam, by Camelot, a French Listed-placed 1m1f winner; interesting on belated debut.
runners.comment: E200,000 yearling; by French Classic winner Victor Ludorum; dam a winner by Camelot

runners.name: Dandymaria
runners.spotlight: Fair debut over 7f at Down Royal, possibly found 6f inadequate at the Curragh; stable among the winners last weekend.
runners.comment: Fair debut over 7f at Down Royal, possibly found 6f inadequate at the  Curragh

runners.name: Capolinea
runners.spotlight: Last of five at Killarney on belated debut; never in serious contention at Galway.
runners.comment: Last of five at Killarney on belated debut, never in serious contention at Galway

runners.name: Susie's Angel
runners.spotlight: Showed inexperience at Galway, not a bad first run in the circumstances; may improve; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, showed inexperience at Galway, not a bad first run in the circumstances

runners.name: Save The Sixes
runners.spotlight: Failed to run up to market expectations on debut; can probably do better; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, failed to run up to market expectations on debut, can probably do better

runners.name: Ballysax Boo
runners.spotlight: Slowly away when down the field first time out at Gowran; huge price then; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, slowly away when down the field first time out at Gowran, huge price then

runners.name: Banish Misfortune
runners.spotlight: Has shown nothing in three outings in recent months; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Has shown nothing in three outings in recent months, can be ruled out.

runners.name: Capall Cuain
runners.spotlight: Has finished towards the back at Fairyhouse and Naas; can be left out of calculations.
runners.comment: Has finished towards the back at Fairyhouse and Naas, can be left out of calculations

races.race_name: WTW Willis Handicap

runners.name: Cool Azul
runners.spotlight: Beaten 2.75l on debut at the Curragh by Thenandnow and 6lb better off with that rival here; got off the mark in a Navan maiden on latest (6f, good); rather speedily bred so whether this trip will suit is up for debate; cheekpieces go on.
runners.comment: Won Navan maiden on latest over 6f, speedily bred so this trip a query; cheekpieces

runners.name: Earls
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; knocking on the door in recent starts; beaten 2.5l when third at Galway on latest; runner up over C&D in May off 2lb lower; frame claims again, especially if it rains.
runners.comment: C&D winner, knocking on the door in recent starts, frame claims again

runners.name: Dolly Hello
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante has shown ability in maidens at 7f-1m; beaten just 2l when third in a Killarney maiden on seasonal return last month and ought to be up to winning races off her current mark; drawn wide but not discounted.
runners.comment: Handicap debutante, promise in maidens at 7f-1m, can win off this mark, drawn wide

runners.name: Venetian Star
runners.spotlight: Narrowly denied at Fairyhouse in May (7f, good) and again at Limerick in June (7f, soft); bombed out when failing to beat a rival in a 3yo handicap at Leopardstown last time, however, so comes with risks attached.
runners.comment: Has gone close twice this season, bombed out on latest at Leopardstown, risky

runners.name: Engines On
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season but this season's form nowhere near that level; handicapper relenting but needs to get back to best.
runners.comment: Two wins last year, well below best in three runs this season, handicapper relenting

runners.name: Spodo Komodo
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner over 6f last year; mixed bag so far this term; ran a cracker off this mark when beaten a neck at Naas (7f, good) last month; didn't back that up over 6f back there 15 days ago when upset in stalls; needs to rebound.
runners.comment: Fine run at Naas on penultimate, upset in stalls and well beaten latest, must rebound

runners.name: Thenandnow
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden at the Curragh in April (6f, soft); soundly beaten in Listed company on next two starts but back to form when a close third in a fillies' handicap at Fairyhouse (6f, good); not as good over 7f latest and stamina to prove for this trip.
runners.comment: 6f maiden winner, best handicap run came over that trip, stamina to prove

runners.name: Mehman
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner is 1-23 on turf; ran well at Bellewstown and Naas earlier this season but way below best the last twice at Leopardstown & Galway; others arrive in better form.
runners.comment: In decent form earlier this season, way below best the last twice, others preferred

runners.name: Java Wood
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; two good runs two days apart in June, winning at Limerick and close third at Gowran; struggled in both runs at the Galway festival, however, so needs to get back to best.
runners.comment: Limerick win in June, struggled both starts at Galway Festival, needs to rebound; reserve

runners.name: Flaming Rib
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; won seven times in Britain (5f-6f) but yet to hit the same heights for Ado McGuinness; beaten 8l on last two starts at Naas at 6f; stamina concerns over this trip.
runners.comment: Useful sprinter in Britain, yet to hit form for this stable, stamina a query; reserve

runners.name: Sagasti
runners.spotlight: Uneven form this season; good third at Gowran before no show at Fairyhouse; bounced back with a close second at Dundalk before heavy defeat at Galway on latest; not the easiest to predict, could go well if in the mood.
runners.comment: Uneven form this season, not easy to predict, could go well if in the mood

runners.name: Contrary To Law
runners.spotlight: Has improved for handicaps; won off 7lb lower at Fairyhouse (7f, good) and another solid effort off revised mark when a close fourth at Naas on latest; can give another good account but very wide draw not ideal.
runners.comment: Won and close fourth in first two handicaps, can go well again but wide draw tricky

runners.name: Summer Island
runners.spotlight: Two wins at the Curragh this season, both over 7f on good ground; not a bad run off revised mark over 1m there on latest and probably has more improvement to come but tricky draw to contend with here.
runners.comment: Two 7f Curragh wins this season, decent run over 1m latest, tricky wide draw here
runners.owner: Nigel O'Hare & Martin W White & Mark Devlin & C G Bryson

runners.name: Red Hugh O'Donnell
runners.spotlight: Gained second career win off 5lb lower at Killarney in July (1m, good); has come up short twice since and has a bit to prove off his current mark.
runners.comment: Gained second career win at Killarney in July, beaten off revised mark twice since

runners.name: Perfect Base
runners.spotlight: One of better efforts in maidens came over C&D last year; no impact on seasonal return and handicap debut at Leopardstown in June; eased just 1lb for that and others seemingly have stronger credentials but check the market.
runners.comment: Eased just 1lb for modest h'cap debut, others have stronger credentials but check market

runners.name: Tokyo Treasure
runners.spotlight: Well backed and found just one too good on handicap debut at Gowran 11 days ago; 3lb rise for that pleasing effort negated by rider's 5lb claim; could go one place better now.
runners.comment: Found just one too good on h'cap bow, rider's claim negates 3lb rise, big player

runners.name: Mercurial
runners.spotlight: First reserve; has run well in both starts this season; beaten 2.25l when runner up at Listowel when last seen in May; has gone well fresh before and C&D form figures read 224; chance if gets a run.
runners.comment: In good form, off since solid second at Listowel in May, has placed C&D form; reserve

runners.name: Dragon Of Malta
runners.spotlight: 9yo a winner of seven races; won twice last season at the Listowel Festival on heavy ground and has shaped encouragingly on last two starts at Limerick and Galway; rain would boost claims.
runners.comment: Two wins last season, best form on heavy ground, rain would boost claims

races.race_name: District Speciality Coffee Maiden

runners.name: Sunny South West
runners.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner has run excellent races in defeat on his first two starts on the Flat; was only 1.5l behind Eagle Fang at Killarney and he has since run a huge race off 90 in the valuable Q.R. handicap at Galway; has to concede weight to most of these but big chance.
runners.comment: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner, promise both starts on Flat, big chance

runners.name: De Vega Queen
runners.spotlight: 3yo filly shaped with promise on soft and soft to heavy ground at Gowran and Cork in the spring; below par on good ground at Killarney on latest; rated 77 and gets all the allowances but could probably do with some rain.
runners.comment: Rated 77, best efforts on testing ground, gets weight allowances, rain would be a plus

runners.name: Almazann
runners.spotlight: Beaten just a head on debut at Cork in April (10.5f, good) when sent off the 9-4 favourite; no excuses when beaten 2.25l upped to 1m4f at Leopardstown by now 95-rated rival; had subsequent maiden winners behind that day and he should be on the premises again.
runners.comment: Second in both starts, had future maiden winners behind latest, thereabouts again
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Magnum Cor
runners.spotlight: Reportedly green and lugged left throughout when beaten 4.75l on debut at Leopardstown (1m1f, good); however, he did finish off his race well and he's bred to relish this longer trip; enters calculations.
runners.comment: Green and lugged left but stayed on well on debut, this trip should suit, player

runners.name: Teoest
runners.spotlight: Not a bad effort when fourth on debut at Dundalk in May and similar RPR when last of six at the Curragh on latest; will qualify for handicaps after this.
runners.comment: Similar RPRs in maidens at Dundalk and the Curragh, gets a handicap mark after this

runners.name: Purple Bandit
runners.spotlight: Toronado gelding; half-brother to 1m5f-2m winner Carmers (inc Group 2; RPR 115); dam 1m-1m2f winner (inc AW; 88), half-sister to Group 1 winners Lord Shanakill (1m), Forever Together (1m4f) and Together Forever (1m 2yo); blinkered for debut; check the market.
runners.comment: Well related Toronado gelding, blinkered for debut, check the market

runners.name: Possum
runners.spotlight: Slow away and beat just one rival home on debut at the Curragh in June; Shane Foley jumps ship; others hold more pressing claims.
runners.comment: Slow away and beat just one rival on debut, Shane Foley prefers stablemate

runners.name: Daily Wonder
runners.spotlight: Space Blues gelding; half-brother to 1m4f AW/1m6f turf winner Quantum Leap (RPR 90); dam 7f 2yo winner (78), half-sister to 10.5f Group 1 winner Cutlass Bay & 1m4f Group 2 winner Boscobel; probably best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Space Blues gelding, dam 7f 2yo winner, okay pedigree but likely best watched on debut
runners.owner: Mrs Pauline McCourt/Donal O'Leary/Whyte's Stamullen Synd

runners.name: My Girl Jersie
runners.spotlight: Has shown virtually nothing in four maidens at around 1m on a variety of ground; upped in trip and cheekpieces now tried.
runners.comment: Showed nothing in four maidens at around 1m, cheekpieces now tried up in trip

runners.name: Michinaga
runners.spotlight: 125-1 and never landed a blow on debut at Leopardstown 12 days ago; safely held by Magnum Cor on that run.
runners.comment: 125-1 and safely held by Magnum Cor on debut at Leopardstown

runners.name: One Cool County
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and soundly beaten in maidens at Killarney and Gowran; handicaps beckon after this.
runners.comment: No impact in maidens at Killarney and Gowran, handicaps beckon after this

runners.name: Salamina
runners.spotlight: Heavy defeat on debut at Gowran; beaten 17l when last of 11 at Cork on latest; leap of faith required to back her after those two runs.
runners.comment: Struggled in both starts at Gowran and Cork, leap of faith required to back her now

runners.name: Swing Street
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival when 33-1 on debut at Ballinrobe; may need a bit more time.
runners.comment: 33-1 and trailed in last on debut at Ballinrobe, may need more time

runners.name: Venerini
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure odds for both starts and ran accordingly; will be of more interest when tackling handicaps.
runners.comment: Triple figure odds for both starts and ran accordingly, one for handicaps

runners.name: Sea Celia's Star
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a German Group 2 and beat just one rival on Irish debut at Down Royal (1m5f, soft); hard to fancy but yard did win this with a 200-1 shot in 2023.
runners.comment: Hard to fancy on evidence of first two runs, yard won this with 200-1 shot in 2023

runners.name: Ben Lomond
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form over jumps in Britain and tailed off on sole previous Flat start on AW; not easy to make a case for on Irish debut.
runners.comment: Ordinary jumps form, tailed off sole Flat start on AW, can't make a case for

races.race_name: Class Grass Handicap

runners.name: Daonethatgotaway
runners.spotlight: Both previous turf wins have come over 1m but landed a 1m4f handicap at Dundalk in February; eased 4lb for midfield finish at Galway last time and worth checking in the market.
runners.comment: Eased 4lb for midfield finish at Galway on latest, worth checking in the market

runners.name: Deralo Ir
runners.spotlight: No impact in first two runs for this yard; tailed off on latest at Galway and, while likely capable of better, can only be watched unless the market suggests otherwise.
runners.comment: Tailed off on latest at Galway, can only be watched unless the market speaks

runners.name: Enchanted Lady
runners.spotlight: Best effort came over 10.5f in an AW maiden; hasn't figured in first two handicaps but did shape okay in a C&D maiden in mid-May; eased 3lb for 6l defeat at Naas on latest, rider takes off further 5lb and cheekpieces go on; interesting.
runners.comment: Eased 3lb for 6l defeat at Naas, rider takes off 5lb, cheekpieces on, interesting

runners.name: Yquem
runners.spotlight: Scored at Leopardstown (1m1f, gd-fm) in June off basement mark; hiked up 10lb and beaten just 1l back at Leopardstown before staying on well at Gowran on latest (9.5f, good); worth another go at this trip on that evidence; chance.
runners.comment: Won off 10lb lower at Leop' in June, stayed on over 9.5f latest, worth a go at this trip

runners.name: Duke Of Leggagh
runners.spotlight: Won twice on the Flat last year including over C&D off 5lb lower; two runs this term not his best and may need some more help from the handicapper; won't mind if there's rain.
runners.comment: Two wins last year on Flat including over C&D, never won off a mark this high

runners.name: Chopsticks
runners.spotlight: Not the easiest to win with (1-30) but often runs well in defeat; poor efforts on last three starts, however, and needs to get back on track; yard form a positive.
runners.comment: Yard in form but well below best on last three starts, needs to rediscover best

runners.name: Lady Plimsoll
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a 9.5f Ballinrobe claimer last summer; stays this far and should be sharper for latest modest third at Galway but probably hasn't got much in hand off current mark.
runners.comment: Sharper for latest modest third at Galway, probably not a lot in hand off this mark
runners.owner: Athlumney Farms Ltd & Eoin Baxter & Mrs M D O'Callaghan

runners.name: Coulstys Way
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last May off 11lb lower; hinted as though returning to form when an encouraging third at Killarney but then clipped heels and unseated at Galway; likes it here and could go very well.
runners.comment: C&D winner, unseated after clipping heels at Galway, likes it here, could go very well

runners.name: Autocrat
runners.spotlight: First reserve; all six wins have come at Dundalk but did go close over C&D (good) last year when a 0.5l second behind Duke Of Leggagh; is 23lb lower now but hard to fancy on recent showings; 5lb wrong.
runners.comment: Went close over C&D off much higher mark last year, recent form poor, 5lb wrong; reserve

runners.name: Fianna
runners.spotlight: 0-8 last year for Willie McCreery; modest enough start for this yard when beaten 14.5l at Gowran (13.5f, soft); eased 1lb and new headgear combination needs to spark.
runners.comment: Modest start for this yard at Gowran, eased 1lb, new headgear combo needs to spark

runners.name: Catherine Magennis
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante has shown promise in all three maidens at 1m1f-1m5f on varying ground; opening mark may be workable and not discounted, especially if money comes.
runners.comment: Handicap debutante, promise in maidens, opening mark may be workable

runners.name: Piatra Neamt
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; maiden showed a glimmer of promise when fifth off 2lb higher over C&D (yld-sft) in May; down the field at Sligo latest though and 5lb wrong here.
runners.comment: Glimmer over C&D in May, down the field latest at Sligo, 5lb wrong here; reserve

runners.name: Lily Parr
runners.spotlight: Maiden has a race in her and she didn't enjoy the smoothest of passages when catching the eye at Galway last time; eased 1lb and if the forecast rain materialises it would boost her prospects.
runners.comment: Not the clearest of runs on latest at Galway, eased 1lb, rain would boost chance

runners.name: Out On Friday
runners.spotlight: Likeable front running veteran goes well here; last won over C&D in May 2025 off this mark and was beaten a neck in this race last year, again off this mark; showed he retained ability when second at Fairyhouse in May; trip was too far on latest, could make a bold bid.
runners.comment: C&D winner, beaten a neck in this last year, same mark now, could make bold bid

runners.name: Master Sydney
runners.spotlight: Won a bumper here last year (2m, good); best run this year came over C&D when a 5l sixth and 4lb lower now; decent run over hurdles at Kilbeggan 10 days ago; place claims if the forecast rain misses.
runners.comment: Course bumper winner, decent run over timber 10 days ago, place claims if rain misses

runners.name: Summer Snow
runners.spotlight: Six-time winner, most recently at last year's Galway festival over 7f (yielding) off 12lb higher; below best so far in 2026 and stamina a major query on first run beyond 1m2f.
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but out of form this year, stamina a major query at this trip

runners.name: Spy
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort won over hurdles at Listowel in June but has failed to fire in that sphere twice since; returns to the Flat in a first-time visor; others arrive in better form.
runners.comment: Won over hurdles in June, poor twice since in that sphere, visor on for Flat return

runners.name: Double Indian
runners.spotlight: Modest form so far in three maidens at 1m4f-1m6f (including over C&D) and when tailed off in a bumper; bred to do better at some stage so worth a market check on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Modest form in maidens and a bumper, bred to do better at some stage, check market

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Saifo
runners.spotlight: Beat only one home on debut at Doncaster (1m4f, good to firm) last month; drops back in trip on AW debut and should know more this time.
runners.comment: Beat only one home on debut at Doncaster last month but should know more this time

runners.name: Why Not Me
runners.spotlight: Promising second of four on debut at Chelmsford (7f, AW) last November; she makes a belated return to action but the booking of Oisin Murphy may be significant.
runners.comment: Promising second of four on debut at Chelmsford last November.

runners.name: Franschhoek
runners.spotlight: Promising third of 11 on debut at Kempton (1m, AW) in March; absence since is a slight concern but otherwise he holds fair claims.
runners.comment: Promising third on debut at Kempton in March; fair claims back from break

runners.name: Astrid
runners.spotlight: Never competitive after starting slowly when seventh of 12 on debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in April; has had wind surgery since so she may step up.
runners.comment: Never competitive after starting slowly when seventh on debut at Newcastle in April.

runners.name: State Express
runners.spotlight: Beaten over 17l when fourth of five on debut at Yarmouth (1m2f, good to firm) 13 days ago; has a lot of improvement to find.
runners.comment: Beaten over 17l when fourth on debut at Yarmouth and has a lot of improvement to find

runners.name: Sueshine
runners.spotlight: Beat only one rival in her two races on turf last year; first-time cheekpieces are applied on AW debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Beat only one rival in her two races on turf last year; now goes in cheekpieces
runners.owner: R J Manning & Mrs Fiona Williams

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: Javelot
runners.spotlight: Third foal; out of a 1m3f-1m4f AW winner (RPR 89); satisfactory start to his career when fourth to  more experienced rival at Yarmouth (7f, good to firm; 13-2) 16 days ago; likely to know more on this occasion.
runners.comment: Satisfactory debut when 4th at Yarmouth (7f; 13-2); should know more this time

runners.name: Peaberry
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to the frequent scorer Oj Lifestyle (7f-1m2f; RPR 92); clear encouragement from opening effort when fifth of 12 at Southwell (7f; 20-1) three weeks ago; should progress and have a role to play.
runners.comment: Encouraging opening effort at Southwell (7f; 20-1) and should progress

runners.name: Chaise Longue
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and failed to figure in either start at 7f and 1m; her dam was a lightly raced half-sister to the Group 2 winner Nyaleti (1m), but this one looks like she'll need more time; handicaps await soon.
runners.comment: Slowly away, failing to figure in both starts; may need more time; handicaps await soon

runners.name: Maliqui
runners.spotlight: 8,000gns foal, 38,000gns yearling; second foal; out of a 7f winner (including AW; RPR 89); already gelded but, with Oisin Murphy booked (1-3 for the yard in the last five seasons), he merits market scrutiny and consideration for a trainer operating a 13% juvenile strike-rate in 2026 (2-15 on AW).
