runners.comment: 38,000gns yearling; merits market scrutiny with Oisin Murphy booked to ride

runners.name: Dark Detective
runners.spotlight: 26,000gns yearling; fourth foal; out of 5f winner (RPR 96); half-brother to two winners, principally Ange De L'Amour (6f 2yo; 72); stable aren't a regular source of winners in these events, and he's already gelded; monitor only.
runners.comment: 26,000gns yearling; fourth foal; out of a 5f winner (RPR 96); best to monitor only.

runners.name: L B Double U
runners.spotlight: 25,000euros yearling; some promise when sixth on Southwell debut (6f; 17-2) in July when beaten 8l; half-brother to six winners, including the milers Whispering Bell (RPR 90) and Stardayz (81), so the extra furlong is worth exploring.
runners.comment: Some promise on Southwell debut (6f; 17-2) and the  extra furlong is worth exploring.

runners.name: Arlecchino's Moon
runners.spotlight: Slowly away and always behind on Kempton debut (7f; 28-1, beaten 21l) in late June; this half-brother to the 7f AW-1m2f turf winner Titanium is poorly drawn and likely to need more time; look elsewhere.
runners.comment: Slowly away and always behind on Kempton debut (7f; 28-1) in late June; look elsewhere.

runners.name: Backmeifyoucan
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; modest late headway when beaten about 10l on Southwell debut (6f; 28-1) four weeks ago; moves up in trip, with Hector Crouch taking over in the saddle; stablemate of Brazilian Blitz.
runners.comment: Modest late headway on Southwell debut (6f; 28-1) when beaten about 10l; up in trip.

runners.name: Spes Durat Avorum
runners.spotlight: Weakened to finish last of nine on Yarmouth debut (7f, good to firm; 80-1) 16 days ago; switches to AW but no real reason why he should get closer to Javelot (fourth) this time.
runners.comment: Weakened to finish last of nine on Yarmouth debut (7f, good to firm; 80-1) 16 days ago.

runners.name: Brazilian Blitz
runners.spotlight: Few positives to take from AW runs at Newcastle and Southwell (both 7f); will soon be eligible for a handicap mark; unlikely today.
runners.comment: Few positives to take from 7f AW starts at Newcastle and Southwell; unlikely candidate.

runners.name: April's Luck
runners.spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; weakened to finish last of 12 on last week's Kempton debut (7f; 40-1); this swift turnaround is another part of the learning curve; others more obvious.
runners.comment: Weakened to finish last of 12 on last week's Kempton debut (7f; 40-1)
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 6 & Hold My Beer

runners.name: Without Fail
runners.spotlight: 28,000gns breeze-up purchase; dwelt and ran green throughout on last week's Kempton debut (7f; 40-1) when beaten 13l; hard to consider as a viable contender on that evidence.
runners.comment: Dwelt, ran green throughout when beaten 13l on last week's Kempton debut (7f; 40-1)

races.race_name: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Handicap

runners.name: Spaceman
runners.spotlight: Shaped with a deal of promise on his first run at beyond sprint trips/handicap debut at Southwell three weeks ago, when not helped by the way the race panned out; will have learned more again from that and should go well.
runners.comment: Shaped with a deal of promise at Southwell three weeks ago; still learning; should go well

runners.name: He's A Gentleman
runners.spotlight: Winner here off 2lb lower last October, his third over C&D; last month's Chester comeback from a short break should have brought him on and he holds each-way claims under Oisin Murphy, who boasts a good record for the yard.
runners.comment: Winner here off 2lb lower last October, his third over C&D; holds each-way claims

runners.name: Haaderr
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden on Tapeta last autumn before being gelded; pulled hard and didn't look to enjoy Catterick at a short price on his comeback last month, before a better effort from the front in the tongue-tie latest; needs more but his yard's in flying form.
runners.comment: Better from the front in the tongue-tie latest; needs more but his yard's in flying form

runners.name: Inside Story
runners.spotlight: Won her maiden on Tapeta and turned in her best effort of the year back on the AW over C&D late last month, when coming away with the winner/favourite; not as well drawn tonight and is 3lb higher but holds claims nonetheless.
runners.comment: Best effort of the year back on the AW over C&D late last month; player upped 3lb

runners.name: Padua
runners.spotlight: Found the race not run to suit at Epsom early last month, when hanging left, but then pulled way too hard in front on his Tapeta debut latest; that was far from the first time he'd over-raced and much will hinge on how he settles early from the inside stall.
runners.comment: Pulled too hard latest; much will hinge on how he settles early from the inside stall
runners.owner: P C J Dalby & R D Schuster

runners.name: Packetofbiscuits
runners.spotlight: Dual Southwell winner off lower marks early in the year who ran poorly there when last seen and has been off for almost four months since; would need a career-best in order to take this.
runners.comment: Dual Southwell winner off lower marks early in the year; would need a career-best effort
runners.owner: A Pot To Pete In Syndicate

runners.name: Shaw Park
runners.spotlight: Generally struggled early in the year and returns from a break of five months; wins have all come after a recent outing and does most of his racing at a lower level now, so has a bit to overcome.
runners.comment: Generally struggled early in the year and returns from a break of five months

runners.name: Havanagreattime
runners.spotlight: Dual 7f Polytrack winner in his younger days but does most racing now over 6f; made a poor debut in a claimer for his new yard here last month, having been picked up for 10,000gns from Richard Hughes last autumn; surprise to see him take this.
runners.comment: Poor debut in a claimer for his new yard here last month; surprise to see him take this

runners.name: Percy's Lad
runners.spotlight: Missed more than 18 months prior to a few lesser efforts in the spring, but has found his level again; enjoyed the run of the race when winning narrowly on Polytrack last Wednesday but set to go well again under a penalty for a yard in good nick.
runners.comment: Won narrowly on Polytrack last week; set to go well again for a yard in good nick

runners.name: Naepoint
runners.spotlight: Three turf wins over a straight 1m for Edward Bethell as a 3yo, latterly off a 2lb lower mark, before struggling during a limited campaign last year; would need a career-best effort for his new yard (also responsible for Spaceman) back from 11 months off.
runners.comment: Would need a career-best effort for his new yard back from 11 months off

races.race_name: Surestore Self Storage Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Samra Star
runners.spotlight: Gave willingly to brush off a 5lb penalty at Musselburgh (1m1f, good) 11 days ago; steps up in grade (from 4lb higher) in pursuit of the hat-trick for an in-form trainer; no issue with this track, so obvious claims with Oisin Murphy aboard.
runners.comment: Steps up in grade in pursuit of the hat-trick; obvious claims with Oisin Murphy aboard
runners.owner: The Hon Heather Galbraith & C Maxwell

runners.name: Mimi's Magic
runners.spotlight: 0-8; weakened late when runner-up over 9.5f here (12-1) in May; has regressed race by race since; returns to AW in added visor with plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Runner-up over 9.5f here in May; poor since; returns to AW in added visor; plenty to prove

runners.name: Gladiadora
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Kempton (1m; 11-4 favourite) on penultimate start, and didn't get the breaks at Windsor (1m) subsequently; has a few foibles - unseated rider in the paddock at Newmarket - but she's still a possible from 2lb above last winning mark.
runners.comment: Didn't get the breaks at Windsor (1m) latest; possible from 2lb above last winning mark
runners.owner: Mrs R Coleman And G Glendining

runners.name: Goldie Trickett
runners.spotlight: Placed on first start for this trainer at Southwell (1m; hooded) in April; hasn't kicked on since, but did emerge with a suitable excuse (lost both hind shoes) when a beaten 6-4 favourite at Nottingham (1m2f) latest; slowly easing mark.
runners.comment: Suitable excuse (lost both hind shoes) when beaten favourite at Nottingham (1m2f) latest

runners.name: Blue Celestial
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; some consistent efforts though, losing out narrowly on her last two starts, including to Sunshine And Roses over C&D; handicap mark continues to rise (up another 2lb) which won't make life easier; still merits respect.
runners.comment: 0-12, losing out narrowly last twice; handicap mark (up another 2lb) continues to rise

runners.name: Sunshine And Roses
runners.spotlight: Pounced to break her duck over C&D (beat Blue Celestial by half-a-length) on penultimate start; gave a good account of herself back on turf when second at Haydock (1m) subsequently; it's likely she'll be in the mix again with Rose Dawes retaining the ride.
runners.comment: C&D winner (beat Blue Celestial) penultimate; runner-up at Haydock (1m) since; in the mix

runners.name: Khepri
runners.spotlight: Not many positives to take from her efforts in novice/maiden company, 'the pick' a never dangerous fourth of ten at Pontefract (1m2f; 40-1) in early July; AW switch, and visor, could yield improvement on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Low key (0-3); AW switch, and visor, could yield improvement on handicap debut

runners.name: Albertini Star
runners.spotlight: Uplift for fitting of a hood (absent tonight), and a switch to handicap company; lacked pace when third at Sandown (1m2f, good to firm; 12-1) four weeks ago; dropping back to 8.5f isn't the most obvious play, but she's on the same mark.
runners.comment: Lacked pace when third at Sandown (1m2f; 12-1) four weeks ago; 8.5f with headgear off?

runners.name: Sailor's Return
runners.spotlight: Ex-French; modest turf efforts (7f-1m) for this trainer, easing a further 2lb since finishing fourth at Ripon (1m, good; 7-2, didn't find much off the bridle) a fortnight ago; more positively, that form received a minor boost at Doncaster on Saturday.
runners.comment: Ex-French; modest turf efforts (7f-1m) for this trainer; others tick plenty more boxes

runners.name: Delevingne Dream
runners.spotlight: Hasn't managed to beat too many rivals across four starts and was last of seven on Ripon handicap debut (1m, good; 9-1) one month ago; now 2lb lower, with added cheekpieces, for AW return; tough to consider.
runners.comment: Last of seven on Ripon handicap debut (1m, good; 9-1); cheekpeices on; tough to consider

races.race_name: Maggies Handicap

runners.name: Sargent Dennis
runners.spotlight: Beat Percy's Star when easily winning his maiden on turf in the spring; difficult to know what happened on his handicap debut off 2lb higher late last month, but possible he needed that and it's still early days.
runners.comment: Difficult to know what happened on his handicap debut but it's still early days with him

runners.name: Arishka's Dream
runners.spotlight: Won his maiden over C&D in February, since when he's been turned over four times as favourite in handicaps; last two efforts, including one having been gelded, were particularly poor, and leave him plenty to prove; stable in fine form, though.
runners.comment: Been turned over four times as favourite in handicaps; last two efforts particularly poor

runners.name: Percy's Star
runners.spotlight: Found an ordinary 5f handicap when making all at Leicester (first-time cheekpieces) in early summer; put up a harsh 8lb for that, didn't back up the effort next time and has been off for seven weeks since; needs more on his AW debut.
runners.comment: Raised a harsh 8lb for his Leicester win and held next time; needs more on his AW debut

runners.name: Fizzy Cristal
runners.spotlight: Ridden positively for two 6f Newcastle wins and found the race not panning out to suit under a more patient ride upped to 7.2f here a month ago; back on her last successful mark and should fare better.
runners.comment: Latest effort here maybe best ignored; back on last successful mark and should fare better

runners.name: Soca Star
runners.spotlight: Consistent maiden who's proved competitive in handicaps this season without looking to have anything in hand, or anything left in the way of improvement; still has each-way claims coming back up from 5f.
runners.comment: Consistent maiden who's proved competitive in handicaps this season; holds each-way claims

runners.name: Acclaimed Freedom
runners.spotlight: Newly gelded; had excuses with one thing and another this year; this mark looks within range and there are positives back on the AW, and under Oisin Murphy, who boasts a decent record for the yard; shortlisted.
runners.comment: Had excuses with one thing and another this year; can do better having been gelded
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Escape Plan
runners.spotlight: Bath blowout in the spring can be ignored but he started a big price when last of seven on his return from a break a fortnight ago; while the return to the AW may do the trick, others hold stronger claims.
runners.comment: While the return to the AW may do the trick, others hold stronger claims

runners.name: Up The Agenda
runners.spotlight: Progressive on the AW last winter, winning three times, latterly off tonight's mark; the return to Tapeta and drop back from 7f will help, with the visor experiment quickly binned, but he hasn't been in any form in three runs back from a break.
runners.comment: Progressive on the AW last winter; not been in any form in three runs back from a break

races.race_name: Self Storage Association Handicap

runners.name: Heroics
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive stepping up in trip and got off the mark at the fifth attempt, at Sandown (1m6f, good) in June; wasn't able to handle the step up in class at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) last month when fifth of seven but holds obvious claims back on AW at this level.
runners.comment: Stepped up in trip and got off the mark at the fifth attempt, at Sandown in June.

runners.name: So Alex
runners.spotlight: Both wins came at this track (1m4f) at the end of last year; runner-up in a couple of turf handicaps since, but was below his best when fifth of eight at Sandown (1m6f, good) last month; the return to this track may see him in a better light.
runners.comment: Both wins came at this track at the end of last year.

runners.name: Kakirra
runners.spotlight: Has shone since reverting to handicaps, winning twice here (1m4f) and he completed a four-timer at Newbury (15.5f, good to firm) last month; no disgrace in finishing second to a fellow improver at Sandown (1m6f, good to firm) last time and looks sure to be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Has shone since reverting to handicaps, completing a four-timer at Newbury last month.

runners.name: Percy Jones
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort whose four wins have all been at this track between 1m4f to around 2m; well-handicapped on his best form but hasn't won for 12 months and some of his younger rivals may have more scope.
runners.comment: Versatile sort who's four wins have all been at this track between 1m4f-around 2m.

runners.name: White Storm
runners.spotlight: 11l second to a subsequent Royal Ascot flop in novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) on debut in May; has finished last in both starts on turf since and return to AW on handicap debut needs to show him in a better light.
runners.comment: Return to AW on handicap debut needs to show him in a better light.

runners.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a Kempton AW handicap in July last year when trained by Tom Ward; had an unsuccessful stint over hurdles this year for current yard, and well held in a couple of 2m handicaps since; drops back in trip on AW return and best watched for now.
runners.comment: Sole success came at Kempton in July last year; held in a couple of 2m handicaps since

runners.name: Dance Time
runners.spotlight: All six wins have been on AW, the latest over C&D last November off 3lb lower; not so good on turf but was runner up at Carlisle (1m6f, good) last Tuesday which holds her in good stead for this return to AW.
runners.comment: All six wins have been on AW, the latest over C&D last November off 3lb lower.

runners.name: Flash Kozo
runners.spotlight: Took advantage of a career-low mark and return to Southwell AW, where he had shown his best form previously, to get off the mark last month; 5lb higher and holds claims if able to reproduce his best at this different track.
runners.comment: Got off the mark at Southwell last month; 5lb higher.
runners.owner: D Bevan And Mrs D Bevan

runners.name: Velvet Whisper
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with two slow-ground wins on turf from the front (1m2f/1m4f); safely held twice on good ground this year (1m4f/1m2f) and needs to show more on this step up in trip on AW return.
runners.comment: Both wins on slow ground on turf; steps up in trip on AW return.
runners.owner: C Wright, D Kilburn, A Dick And P Snook
